v5.10.31 - Pre-finals skill-point reserve
Added ----- - Reserve Skill Points (Skills - Pre-Finals plan, 0 = off): hold back a set number of skill points on the pre-finals purchase so they carry to the career-complete purchase, where the full skill list is known. Useful for banking toward a strong gold skill instead of letting the optimizer spend everything on filler pre-finals. The reserve caps the whole pre-finals purchase; it never applies at career-complete, where leftover points are lost anyway.
